decision: Kenny chose 'Warn, don't block' on a decision card in the 'Fix gaps in unused materials' thread (28 Oct 2026 09:28 UTC): 'The gate counts the declared allergens and IFRA items and passes the base with a named "undeclared part" warning'.
scope: PerfumersWorld bases Kenny owns whose SDS section 3 and IFRA certificate (51st Amendment) are recorded. The declared part is counted (IFRA items through ifra_annex1_constituents.json, the allergens below toward the EU declaration); the undeclared part has no physics or threshold and is named in a warning instead of failing the gate. A base whose page publishes nothing stays in ifra_undisclosed_bases.json.
source_note: Values re-read on PerfumersWorld product and document pages, 28 Oct 2026 (/mnt/project-files/unused-gaps-20261028/group2/g2_08_bases/VALUES.md). Grade B: producer documents, not the IFRA Standards text. Percentages are of the base as supplied.

bases.undeclared_note: tea-leaf-derived material and components the SDS does not classify

bases.undeclared_note: the dried-fruit and balsamic character; the certificate lists no restricted materials

bases.name: Sandalwood Base X3

bases.name: Costus Olifac
bases.declaration_document: IFF Fragrance Product Information Sheet, COSTUS OLIFFAC 2020, Sales No. 30F35189, Document ID 3297145, 15 Feb 2024
bases.undeclared_note: the costus, animalic and leathery odorants; IFF's 2020 formula, PerfumersWorld's lot version not verified (closest-identity proxy). Percentages are of the neat base; Kenny's stock is PW's ready-made 10% in DPG

bases.name: Suederal
bases.declaration_document: IFF Fragrance Product Information Sheet, SUEDERAL LT 2010 /2020, Sales No. 30809720, Document ID 3255950, 31 Jan 2024
bases.undeclared_note: the suede and leather odorants; IFF does not publish them. PROXY_IDENTITY_UNCONFIRMED: PerfumersWorld never names the maker of 3UP14351; it lists 'Suederal LT' among its synonyms and its MSDS density band (0.94-0.99 at 25 C) meets IFF's, so IFF Suederal LT is the closest published identity (Kenny's closest-identity rule), not a confirmed one. Allergens: IFF FPIS section 14 and IFF's EU allergen sheet for Suederal LT 2010/2015 (https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0682/1448/9400/files/EU_Fragrance_Allergens_SUEDERAL_IFF.PDF) both give limonene 0.002 % and every other allergen under 10 ppm; PerfumersWorld's declaration lists none. Percentages are of the neat base; Kenny's stock is his own 10% in DPG
